name: unattended
description: Run work unattended and trust the result. brief: interview the user until they have decided what they want, then freeze it as a written brief an unattended run can build against. go: carry a frozen brief to a checked result inside the approved cap, with proof of done and the user's decisions last. arbiter: keep the judge of done out of the worker's reach, with the arbiter-loop script on PATH.
